about_the_game:
Fleet is a light rogue-like game infused with real-time tactical elements. Players select distinct initial fleets, purchase and upgrade various ships throughout the game, and assemble massive fleets with unique styles to defeat wave after wave of enemy fleets.

Game Features

  • Fast-paced, with each game lasting no more than 30 minutes.

  • Simple to operate—some ship combinations require no manual input at all!

  • With dozens of ships to choose from—ranging from small fighters to massive carriers, from combat vessels to engineering ships—you're sure to find your favorite combination.

  • With hundreds of weapons and equipment to choose from, you can either build a massive fleet to overwhelm your enemies with sheer numbers or arm a small elite force to defeat superior odds.

  • Custom difficulty allows you to adjust enemy strength to find a playstyle that suits you.

  • Convenient MOD creation mode: All in-game data is configured in text format. Simply copy files and modify values to create MODs, unleashing your creativity and that of other players!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600/AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060/AMD RX 480/Intel ARC A380
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-12600/AMD Ryzen 5 7600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1080 TI/AMD RX5700/Intel ARC A580
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Fleet is a light rogue-like game with real-time tactical elements. Players take on the role of a commander, assembling diverse space fleets to repel wave after wave of enemy forces. You can also integrate your wildest ideas into the game by expanding it with MODs.
